question: If the marked price of an article is ₹7,895 and the discount offered is 4.2%, then the selling price (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Selling Price (SP) is the Marked Price (MP) minus the discount percentage.

⇒ SP = (100 − 4.2)% of MP

⇒ SP = 95.8% of 7895

⇒ SP = 7895 × 0.958 = 7563.41

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,563.41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹7,895

Discount offered = 4.2%

**Formula Used:**

Discount Amount = MP × (Discount% ÷ 100)

Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount Amount
